summary: Campaign Manager does not ship these projects. Install each one from its upstream repository into every client that runs campaigns with a profile that requires it.

hermes.method: Hermes plugin from the upstream repository
hermes.notes: With the default plugins.scan_on_install setting, Hermes blocks this community source after its security scan. Review the findings, then repeat the command with --force if you accept them. Add --yes-deps for a non-interactive install.
hermes.verified: Linux, disposable Hermes profile: blocked without --force; installed and enabled at the tested commit with --force.

codex.steps: In Codex, open /plugins, search for superpowers and select Install Plugin. See the upstream README for the Codex app.
codex.verified: Upstream-documented; not re-tested for this release.

hermes.method: Upstream clone registered as a Hermes external skill directory
hermes.notes: Add <directory>/skills to skills.external_dirs in the profile's config.yaml. Hermes does not security-scan external directories, so review the clone before adding it. Installing skills one by one with hermes skills install is not sufficient: the scanner blocks literature-review even with --force.
hermes.verified: Linux, disposable Hermes profile: all 15 skills listed as enabled external skills.

codex.steps: Follow .codex/INSTALL.md in the upstream repository: clone to ~/.codex/co-researcher, add its hook section to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and run its bootstrap command.
codex.verified: Upstream-documented; not re-tested for this release.
